Item #: SCP-8675309

Object Class: Safe

Special Containment Procedures:

A standard room, furnished with one(1) end table, one(1) lamp, one(1) five(5) foot long male-to-male telephone cable, and one(1) telephone jack wired into the local telephone network. SCP-8675309 must be kept in a facility that has no local 867 prefix, so as to not have local residents accidentally called in case of containment breach. SCP-8675309 must be placed on the end table, directly beneath the lamp, and jacked into the local telephone jack using the male-to-male telephone cable. End table must be located no further than 5 feet from the telephone jack, and must not be moved under any circumstances. Room must be soundproofed and have no windows.

No D-class personnel are allowed to be present during testing. Said testing must be preformed by a team of doctors who have been briefed on SCP-8675309's containment procedures and properties/effects. At least one(1) agent trained in hand-to-hand combat and armed with a taser must be present outside of the containment in case of breach. Exposure to D-class personnel, or any doctors/agents not briefed on SCP-8675309's procedures/properties will possibly lead to an overwhelming desire to use SCP-8675309 to call "Jenny" (SCP-8675309-1), and if denied, a psychotic break in said personnel may occur.

In the event of a psychotic break, said personnel must be restrained, removed from SCP-8675309's containment, and administered sedatives. If administered sedatives have no effect, class A or B amnesiacs must be administered. Personnel must then be isolated and monitored for at least five(5) days. If said personnel show a desire to use a telephone to contact a person known as "Jenny" (SCP-8675309-1), then said personnel must be terminated.

Description:

SCP-8675309 appears to be an early 1980's touch tone telephone, two-tone in color (white base, black receiver) with a tone/pulse dialing switch located on the lower center-right side. SCP-8675309 will exert a compulsion upon anyone within a 30 foot radius to pick up its receiver and dial the telephone number "867-5309". No area code is ever dialed, and the affected person(s) don't seem to care. Once containment has been breeched (the number "867-5309" dialed), the affected subject will begin to mumble something to the effect of "come on Jenny, answer the phone". The "Jenny" referred to is known as SCP-8675309-1.

After a few rings, the subject will slam the receiver back down onto the phone's carriage in frustration, and begin to sweat profusely. Subjects who were successfully sedated and contained for the above mentioned five(5) day period - with no administration of amnestics - recall needing to call SCP-8675309-1 as the subject had met her in a bar, and she had given him (or her) "her" telephone number and name. Subject can never recall the date, time or place that they met SCP-8675309-1 - only that it was a bar. Subjects who are in a committed relationship seem to exert the most control over the after effects of SCP-8675309 breach.

Those not in a committed relationship begin to show signs of obsession, and start displaying stalker-like and voyeristic behavior (such as peeping through the windows of other windowed containments, hoping to get a glimpse of SCP-8675309-1). Such subjects showing this behavior must be forcefully restrained by agents trained in hand-to-hand combat or by the use of a taser. Class A or B amnesiacs have to be administered to the subject, depending on the severity of their resistance. Subjects must then be contained and monitored for five(5) days in order to make sure the affects of SCP-8675309 have worn off. If subject(s) show a desire to contact SCP-8675309-1 on ANY telephone during this time period, subject(s) must be terminated, as their behaviors become more erratic and unfit for societal re-integration.

No other option but to get a wired connection as wireless will mean unstable latency (results from pings). Since your priority is low latency and if there's no other option than your 1Mbps DSL, you're stuck with it.

A more costly approach will be getting wireless service along with your current DSL line.
